why_this_packet_exists: E9 is explicitly test-only and cannot modify production code.
Pre-E9 tracing showed run_extraction_v5.call_llm did not accept or forward service_tier, prompt_cache_directives, or disabled_providers to llm_runtime.call_llm.
The selected model_map v3 route row carried service_tier and cache_strategy, but run_extraction_v5 only consumed strict-output fields from the route entry.
Projected, reserved, and runtime spend accounting used cfg.default_service_tier unless a provider echoed service_tier, so route-specific service_tier was not priced before E9 integration coverage.
behavior_changes: run_extraction_v5.call_llm now forwards service_tier, prompt_cache_directives, and disabled_providers to llm_runtime.call_llm.
run_extraction_v5._route_attempt now resolves the selected route entry for both strict and non-strict paths, derives route service_tier/cache directives, and passes them into sync LLM calls.
run_extraction_v5 projected, reserved, and runtime spend accounting accepts route service_tier so route metadata is priced when providers do not echo the tier.

Batch request metadata now includes route service_tier/cache_strategy/cache_strategy_applied so the existing batch client can put supported service_tier into the wire body and proofs retain the optimizer intent.
